engineering_and_documentation.role: implementation, test, integration, experiment package preparation, and documentation generation
engineering_and_documentation.when_unavailable: keep task queued and report the unavailable requested model; do not silently substitute another model

sample_analysis_statistics_bad_case_root.role: sample analysis, metric/statistical recomputation, error analysis, and bad-case root-cause analysis

planning_evaluation_replanning.role: task planning, result evaluation, adversarial review, go/no-go judgment, and replanning
planning_evaluation_replanning.restriction: must not be used as the implementation or sample-analysis owner

handoff_requirements.record_path: task-local HANDOFF.md or CephFS task directory

routing_invariants: Astra decisions must be based on bounded artifacts and must not replace implementation evidence.
Sol analysis must report measurements and causes with evidence, not make final plan decisions.
Terra engineering/documentation tasks must not be silently reassigned while Terra is unavailable.
NPU execution remains detached and script-controlled; model routing does not change resource or TEST gates.

execution_contract.parent_log_access: no raw log ingestion; use bounded script-produced digests
execution_contract.precedence: supersedes earlier Agent-tool dispatch instructions for future parallel work; preserves model roles and scientific gates
